name: simulator-deep-linker
title: SimulatorDeepLinker
description: Search and open saved deep links on iOS and Android developer devices.
author: shtefan_boblik

commands.name: search-deep-links
commands.title: Search Deep Links
commands.description: Search saved links and open them on the configured target

preferences.name: storageFile
preferences.title: Storage Override
preferences.description: Optional deeplinks.json override. The SimulatorDeepLinker storage is detected automatically.

preferences.name: defaultEnvironment
preferences.title: Default Environment
preferences.description: Used when the configured environment exists, for example Development.

preferences.name: platform
preferences.title: Target Platform
preferences.description: Choose how the CLI should open selected links.

preferences.name: target
preferences.title: Target Identifier
preferences.description: Optional for iOS Simulator (defaults to booted). Required for physical Apple devices and Android.

preferences.name: bundleIdentifier
preferences.title: Apple Bundle Identifier
preferences.description: Required only for a physical iPhone or iPad.

preferences.name: androidPackage
preferences.title: Android Package
preferences.description: Optional package used to constrain Android link handling.
